collection.description: Two siblings have avoided each other for days after a quarrel.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: (sibling1) and (sibling2), two siblings, have avoided each other for days after a quarrel.

a1.name: Outcome A1
a1.text: Both siblings admit they missed talking.

a2.name: Outcome A2
a2.text: One sibling is ready to speak while the other is not.

b1.name: Outcome B1
b1.text: The note opens a gentle conversation.

b2.name: Outcome B2
b2.text: The sibling appreciates the note but does not respond immediately.

c1.name: Outcome C1
c1.text: A shared game eases the tension.

c2.name: Outcome C2
c2.text: The activity feels strained, and they stop without blame.

d1.name: Outcome D1
d1.text: They reconnect naturally a few days later.

d2.name: Outcome D2
d2.text: The delay reveals that the argument hurt more deeply than expected.
